== Biography ==
Marion Glasgow was born 4 Sep 1840, christened on 13 Sept 1840 in New Monkland, Lanarkshire, Scotland. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-424|John Glasgow]] and [[Forsyth-878|Christina Forsyth]]. <ref>"Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XYWD-5Y2 : 16 September 2021), Marrion Glasgow, 1840.</ref> <ref>
'''Child Baptism''':
"Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950"<br/>
[https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ49-6B1 FamilySearch] (accessed 11 October 2021)<br/>
Christian Forsyth in entry for Marrion Glasgow, 1840.
</ref>

In 1841 Marion was living in Arden, Clarkston with her parents and sister.<ref>(Scotland Census 1841:Parish:Clarkston; ED:6b; Page;16; Line:1370; Year:1841)</ref>


== Research Notes ==
